Our notes

Our classic Work Boots have been trusted since 2013 as the "go anywhere, do anything" boot. Now, in response to customer demand, we’re offering a Wide Fit model that combines the rugged durability of our original with the extra room and comfort of an EE width fitting. Our standard fit models have a D width fitting, already slightly wider than most brands, while these wide fit versions provide even more room for enhanced comfort. Whether you’re trekking the trails or handling a busy day on your feet, these boots are designed to support you every step of the way.

Engineered for Endurance Crafted to last, our Wide Fit Work Boots have been refined over the years to meet the highest standards of vegan footwear. Unlike products designed for short-lived trends, these boots are here to stay, allowing us to continually improve and perfect every detail. Made with breathable, water-resistant vegan leather (69% bio-oil content), they’re designed to handle the elements. Deep tread solid rubber outsoles, containing recycled content, deliver grip and durability wherever your day takes you.

Comfort-Driven Details Inside, you’ll find vegan suede linings that enhance breathability, making them comfortable to wear all day. The wide fit EE width offers additional space without sacrificing style, perfect for those who need a little more room.

Signature Features

  • Durable Uppers: Breathable and water-resistant, made with our signature vegan leather (69% bio-oil content).
  • Reinforced Outsoles: Deep tread rubber outsoles with recycled content for exceptional grip.
  • Recycled Materials: Strong laces and large rear pull tabs made from recycled polyester, embroidered with WVS for easy on-and-off.
  • Comfy Vegan Suede Lining: Keeps your feet comfortable and improves breathability for long-lasting wear.
  • Stylish Finishes: Stitching details throughout and WVS embossing on the tongue and outsole as a mark of quality.

Designed to go the distance, our Wide Fit Work Boots combine enhanced comfort, durability, and a timeless design, ensuring they’re as comfortable on the first wear as they are for years to come.

    Men's Footwear Size Chart

    We've made this chart to help you choose the right size.

    You'll need your foot length measurement.

    Once you've found your perfect fit with us, you can select the same size for all other models.

    Our footwear has regular width and volume.

    If you're unsure about choosing between two sizes, we recommend sizing up.

    There's no need to add anything to these measurements. They already include extra space for wiggle room.

    How to take your foot length measurement

    Stand on a hard surface with your heel against a wall.

    Measure your foot from the heel to the longest point of your toes.

    This number is your foot measurement. You can use it in our chart to choose the correct shoe size.

    It may be helpful to measure both feet as something one foot can measure differently from the other.
